title: Bias in the Mirror: Are LLMs opinions robust to their own adversarial attacks ?

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model agreement on a continuous scale (-10 to +10) using questions adapted from the Political Compass test before and after the models engage in structured self-debates.
Prompting models in multiple languages (English, Arabic, and Chinese) and comparing the shifts in their stance to assess how linguistic training data and cultural contexts influence bias expression.

bias_targets.target: Sociocultural bias (Race, Gender, Sexuality, and Religion)
bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the robustness of model opinions by tracking shifts in agreement scores on sensitive sociocultural statements (e.g., abortion, same-sex adoption, racial superiority) after exposure to both fair and biased LLM-generated debates.
Testing the models' susceptibility to illogical claims or conspiracy theories (e.g., 5G networks, drawing circles vs. triangles) to measure baseline persuadability and adherence to invalid arguments.
